vibe_rationale: Twenty-five years of grassroots, artist-run independent publishing; small, low-commercial and well trusted in its scene.
fit_notes: Creative, adult-leaning zine makers and readers with weak wellness adjacency; brand presence is rare in zine culture. Community, fiscal and venue partners only, with a partnership page but no commercial sponsors. Any role should be quiet support, such as a commissioned zine or a water point. US-based.
